title: Letter architecture
technique: One ray-marched shader draws a folded fractal of blocks with lettering embossed into its surfaces, seen as a 1-bit shaft or as a flat red slice.
music: Bass and vocal pitch change the fold angles so each note reshapes the lattice. In the shaft every kick sends a pane of light down it, the snare flips the frame to its negative and the shaft snaps a quarter turn every four beats. In the cut every kick pushes the slice deeper and spreads a ring over it, the snare heats the red to orange and hi-hats flash random cells.

takes.name: Shaft
takes.description: A plunge down a square shaft lined with huge extruded phrase letters and square ring lights, drawn in dithered 1-bit black and white that flips to its negative on the snare.
words: EACH DOT IS BLACK OR WHITE.
THE SNARE SWAPS BLACK AND WHITE.
NO GREY NO GREY NO GREY

takes.name: Cut
takes.description: A flat, poster-like view square onto a diagonal slice through the lattice, with the cut face painted red, phrases knocked out in white, and soft white clay showing through the holes.

as_processor: Uses the picture in place of the lettering: its brightness becomes raised relief on the fractal and its colour becomes the paint, shown on the walls of the shaft in 1-bit dither or as a poster on the red cut face.
